status: frozen before fitting any higher-order harmonic basis
purpose: Test whether the v16B failure of the harmonic boundary oracle in PLCK G287 was caused only by truncating the analytic exterior-potential expansion at m=6.
decision_rule: If both clusters close at least half of boundary power by m=12 and PLCK G287 gains at least 0.1 power fraction over m=6, the low-order oracle was insufficient, but the required high-order structure must still be predicted by measured baryons before a boundary mechanism advances.
If PLCK G287 remains below half-power at m=12, the static harmonic-boundary failure is robust to this order expansion.
These target-derived harmonic coefficients are an upper bound only and are never theory parameters.
claim_boundary: This is a disclosed post-failure sensitivity on two spent comparator maps.
Increasing harmonic order after seeing the m=6 result cannot replace the v16B primary score.
The compact-halo target includes fitted external shear and is not direct truth.
No observational holdout or raw image position is opened.
